name: factrail
description: Verbatim, fact-keeping context compaction. A thin function-hook shim over the native factrail binary, which holds every policy and compaction decision (hook protocol v1, docs/protocol.md).

binary.title: factrail binary
binary.description: Path or name of the factrail executable the hooks run (argv[0]). A bare name is looked up on PATH; the agentbox entrypoint projects /opt/agentbox/bin/factrail.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to let the binary read FACTRAIL_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY from its environment.

enabledByDefault.title: Enabled by default
enabledByDefault.description: Starting position of the /factrail switch until it is first flipped; the switch itself is persisted in the plugin store.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Who judges what to keep: systemone (TypeSafe System One or a sovereign façade), tev (a Tev-format, OpenAI-compatible endpoint) or rules (the deterministic local rules; no model, nothing sent).

baseUrl.title: Backend endpoint
baseUrl.description: Full URL of the backend's decision endpoint. Unset means the backend's default (the vendor cloud for systemone).

backendLocal.title: Endpoint is on this network
backendLocal.description: DECLARED, never inferred from baseUrl. True lets a tainted session be judged by the backend because nothing leaves the network; false (or anything but true) keeps tainted sessions off the model.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id sent to the backend. Unset means the backend's default.

egress.title: Egress
egress.description: What a non-local backend is sent: full (the verbatim content the judge needs, credentials redacted) or metadata (shapes and sizes only, no content). Any other value means metadata.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: What runs when the model may not be used (no credentials, or a tainted session on a backend not declared local): rules (the local rules compact verbatim and send nothing) or summary (Claude Code's built-in summary).

taintTools.title: Taint tool prefixes
taintTools.description: Comma-separated tool-name prefixes. A session that has ever called one is tainted: it is never sent to a non-local model; the local rules compact it instead. Unset means the binary's default (the private email gateway and Gmail).

taintSkills.title: Taint skills
taintSkills.description: Comma-separated skill names whose load taints the session, with the same effect as taintTools. Unset means the binary's default (email-search).

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum judged probability that a tool call or result is still needed; below it the item is removed or truncated.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated budget for the conversation state per backend request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated budget for state plus questions per backend request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a dropped tool result kept before its note.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Ceiling: percentage of the context window at which a completed turn requests compaction. The effective trigger is the smaller of this and compactAtTokens.

compactAtTokens.title: Compaction tokens
compactAtTokens.description: Absolute trigger in tokens; the effective trigger is min(compactAtPercent of the window, this).

rearmTokens.title: Re-arm growth
rearmTokens.description: After a compaction, re-trigger only once context has grown this many tokens past the post-compaction size. 0 means a quarter of the trigger.

cacheWarm.title: Cache-warm action
cacheWarm.description: When a session above cacheWarmFloorTokens sits idle until just before its prompt cache expires: compact (while the cache is warm), notify (a toast suggesting /compact), or off.

cacheWarmFloorTokens.title: Cache-warm floor
cacheWarmFloorTokens.description: Context size in tokens below which the idle nudge is never armed.

cacheTtlSeconds.title: Prompt-cache TTL (s)
cacheTtlSeconds.description: Prompt-cache lifetime the idle nudge races. 0 means detect: subscription rate limits mean 3600, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY without rate limits means 300, anything else 3600.

cacheTtlMarginSeconds.title: Prompt-cache margin (s)
cacheTtlMarginSeconds.description: How long before expiry the nudge fires (TTL minus this; half the TTL when the margin would exceed half of it).

compactionTimeoutMs.title: Backend deadline (ms)
compactionTimeoutMs.description: Longest wait for the whole backend round. Past it the fallback runs and a late answer is discarded. The plugin allows the binary this plus 10 s. 0 or a negative value means the default.

saveFullOutputs.title: Save full outputs
saveFullOutputs.description: Write the full text of each reduced tool result, secrets masked, under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/factrail/outputs (owner-only, pruned after 30 days).

recordDecisions.title: Record decisions
recordDecisions.description: Append each judged request and its answers to $XDG_DATA_HOME/factrail/decisions for evaluation and training. Never for a tainted session.
